items.question: How many years is the UAE Blue visa residence visa valid for?
items.gold: The Blue visa is a 10-year residence visa.
items.fact: Blue visa is a 10-year residence visa

items.question: Which federal authority can sustainability advocates apply to for the UAE Blue visa?
items.gold: Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security.
items.fact: Blue visa applications go to Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security
